mapper.select: WITH FEE AS (SELECT SUM(T.AMT) AS FEEAMT,T.FEE_TYPE,T.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SPLIT_TRADE_ID IS NULL THEN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_AMT ELSE -1 * TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_AMT END AS AMT, TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_TYPE,TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' WHERE (TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} OR TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId})) T GROUP BY T.FEE_TYPE,T.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE), ATRADE AS ( SELECT SUM(TRADE.TRADE_AMT) TRADE_AMT,SUM(TRADE.M_TRADE_AMT) M_TRADE_AMT,TRADE.SPLIT_TRADE_ID FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(T1.TRADE_AMT, 0)) TRADE_AMT, SUM(NVL(T2.M_TRADE_AMT, 0)) M_TRADE_AMT, T1.SPLIT_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.SPLIT_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND T1.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' GROUP BY T1.SPLIT_TRADE_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM(NVL(T1.TRADE_AMT, 0)) TRADE_AMT, SUM(NVL(T2.M_TRADE_AMT, 0)) M_TRADE_AMT, T1.SPLIT_TRADE_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.SPLIT_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND T1.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' GROUP BY T1.SPLIT_TRADE_ID)TRADE GROUP BY TRADE.SPLIT_TRADE_ID) select TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID as investPortfolioId, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID as tradeId, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE as tradeDate, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION as ps, FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID as pledgeFinprodId, ZY_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.TERM_TYPE as termType, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BASIS as basis, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE as vdate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE as mdate, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.TERM as term, NVL((TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE - TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE),0) as actCapDays, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AS secManageAcctId, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_NAME AS secAcctName, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CCY as ccy, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID as chlId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR AS chlName, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_CPRICE as unitCprice, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_INT as unitInt, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_FPRICE as unitFprice, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_UNIT_CPRICE as mUnitCprice, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_UNIT_INT as mUnitInt, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_UNIT_FPRICE as mUnitFprice, NVL(FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.INT_RATE*100,0) as intRate, NVL(FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100,0) as prinAmt, NVL(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT,0) as tradeAmt, NVL(JYSXFEE.FEEAMT,0) AS jysxFee, NVL(JSFEE.FEEAMT,0) as jsFee, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FPRICE_AMT as firSettleAmtS, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_TRADE_AMT as dueSettleAmtS, JYSXFEES.FEE_AMT AS jysxFeeS, JSFEES.FEE_AMT AS jsFeeS, NVL(ATRADE.TRADE_AMT,0) AS firSettleAmtA, NVL(ATRADE.M_TRADE_AMT,0) AS dueSettleAmtA from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID left join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ON STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ZY_FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = ZY_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FEE JYSXFEE ON JYSXFEE.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B06} LEFT JOIN FEE JSFEE ON JSFEE.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B08} LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL JYSXFEES ON JYSXFEES.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B06} AND JYSXFEES.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL JSFEES ON JSFEES.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B08} AND JSFEES.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN ATRADE ON ATRADE.SPLIT_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL != #{YESORNO_Y} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01}

SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(AMOUNT,0)),0) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(FDP.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100,0)) AS AMOUNT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE FDP on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH = FDP.BRANCH AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FDP.FINPROD_ID WHERE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL GROUP BY TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SPLIT_TRADE_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM(NVL(FDP.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100,0)) AS AMOUNT FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE FDP on WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH = FDP.BRANCH AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FDP.FINPROD_ID WHERE WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL GROUP BY WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SPLIT_TRADE_ID )
SELECT FINPROD_ID,TRADE_ID,PS FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}
